I'd like to talk about my high school English teacher, Ms Hoa. She taught me for three years. What I remember most is that she never made us feel stupid when we made mistakes. She encouraged us to speak, even when our English was terrible. Because of her, I stopped being afraid of speaking in public, and I started to believe that I could learn anything if I practised every day. That attitude has helped me a lot, both in my studies and in my career.
